newsitem.title: USA: Newcourt Credit Group now trades on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Newcourt Credit Group now trades on NYSE.

text.p: Newcourt Credit Group Inc said Wednesday it is now trading its common shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "NCT."
Newcourt has been trading on the Toronto and Montreal stock exchanges since the company's initial public offering in March 1994.
Newcourt said in a release that it currently has 65,218,520 common shares issued and outstanding, representing a market capitalization of about $1.65 billion.
Shares of Newcourt on the NYSE were unchanged at 18-1/2 in mid-day trading Wednesday.
